label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Poulter Knee Injury
items.text: Ian Poulter tore his meniscus hopping up two steps during a LIV Golf event and will have surgery in September but continues competing despite pain.

items.headline: Jaeger Withdraws at Schwab
items.text: Stephan Jaeger withdrew mid-round at the Charles Schwab Challenge due to a back injury confirmed by PGA Tour Communications.

items.headline: Scheffler Headlines Memorial
items.text: World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler will defend his Memorial Tournament title on June 4, joined by Rory McIlroy, Xander Schauffele, and Jordan Spieth while Viktor Hovland withdrew before the deadline.
